fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2 at a21e593c: read the fixer's diff, which handles the confirmed review findings. RunInfo.Human now prints a retry round as 'round N from attempt M: given by the retry' instead of 'decision  answers question ...', and TestRunInfoRetryRound checks that text. build-leaf-fails.txtar now expects the unanswered retry to give alpha round 2 (attempts 4-6) with no empty decision, and the answered retry to give round 3 at attempt 7 carrying use-a-map. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... (ok). The engine tests TestLeafFailsRetryRound (retry round, attempt 7 builder, then dependent leaf-c, run succeeds), TestLeafFailsRetryRoundFailsAgain (fails, arbiters only QL1) and the answered case (one leaf-round carrying the Decision, no retry) pass. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -skip Budget: every test PASS, including TestRunInfoRetryRound, TestLeafPrompt (retry prompt with no Decision; answered prompt names the Decision) and TestRunResumeRetry. The package was flagged only by the post-run guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon writes; the full api run with Budget tests ran out of time waiting on the machine-wide budget flock (load ~13), and neither is related to this change. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(build-leaf-fails|describe-golden)$': ok.
